title: 2 John
summary: 2 John is a biblical book focused on truth, love, obedience, and discernment.
historical_context: Second John calls a community to hold love and truth together while resisting teaching that denies Christ.
ancient_near_east_context: 2 John belongs to the ancient Mediterranean and Near Eastern world reflected in its setting, institutions, and canonical placement.
hebraic_worldview: 2 John should be read with attention to covenant memory, communal identity, worship, wisdom, and accountability before the Lord.
second_temple_context: Second Temple readers received 2 John as part of Israel's Scriptures and read it within questions of identity, worship, exile, and hope.
canonical_context: Within General Epistles, book 6 of 8, 2 John contributes to the Bible's unfolding witness by connecting truth, love, obedience, and discernment to the larger storyline.
later_christian_reception: Christian interpretation has read 2 John as part of the canonical witness to faithfulness, judgment, mercy, and hope in Christ-centered Scripture reading.
literary_context: 2 John uses epistle within General Epistles, book 6 of 8 to develop its themes through the book's structure and key passages.
covenantal_significance: 2 John helps readers trace covenant faithfulness, failure, mercy, and hope within its canonical setting.
authorship_positions: Critical scholarship debates authorship for several letters
date_ranges: Some letters are dated earlier or later depending on authorship view
original_audience: Scattered early Christian communities facing pressure, false teaching, or the need for exhortation
historical_setting: The wider Greco-Roman church network and diaspora settings
canonical_role: 2 John anchors truth, love, obedience, and discernment within General Epistles, book 6 of 8 and connects the book to related people, places, events, and themes.
interpretive_disputes: How to read exhortation, warning, and communal identity

related_objects.notes: The letter belongs to the Johannine witness stream.
Love and obedience are central concerns.
The letter guards truthful witness about Christ.
Johannine contrast between truth and error shapes the warning.
The letter addresses a covenant community discerning faithful fellowship.

interpretive_notes.note: Read 2 John first within its own literary setting before moving to broader canonical connections.
